verdict.rationale: Orama is a search platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, staging, or test-mode environment. Segregated data sources and the ability to migrate between Orama Cloud and the open-source library are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not a documented sandbox isolated from production data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
